title: The Corner of Minnesota You Reach Through Canada #shorts
summary: To reach Minnesota's Northwest Angle by road, you drive about 40 miles through Manitoba, then report to US Customs on the CBP ROAM app.
sources: Minnesota Historical Society, MNopedia, Northwest Angle: farther north than any other part of the contiguous United States; the 1783 line followed John Mitchell's map of an egg-shaped Lake of the Woods; in 1798 David Thompson proved the northernmost source of the Mississippi was south of Lake of the Woods; in 1825 Johann Ludwig Tiarks determined the northwesternmost point at the head of Angle Inlet; 1842 treaty confirmed the point: https://mnopedia.org/node/6088

US Census Bureau, 2020 Census via TIGERweb: Angle township, Lake of the Woods County, MN: population 149, housing units 335, land 323,165,247 m2, water 1,233,153,221 m2 (water = 79% of the area): https://tigerweb.geo.census.gov/arcgis/rest/services/TIGERweb/tigerWMS_Census2020/MapServer/20/query?where=GEOID%3D%272707701550%27&outFields=NAME,GEOID,POP100,HU100,AREALAND,AREAWATER&returnGeometry=false&f=json

Lake of the Woods Tourism, Northwest Angle: from Warroad MN-313 into Manitoba, 12.6 miles to MB-308, 27 miles to MB-525; the drive goes through Canada for about 40 miles; or a boat across about 40 miles of big water; winter ice trails and groomed snowmobile trails; 'not connected to the rest of Minnesota by land'; 'This is an unmanned border'; check in by resort iPad, ROAM station or the ROAM app; check out of Canada at the Jim's Corner booth or 888-CAN-PASS and write down the verification number: https://lakeofthewoodsmn.com/northwest-angle/
Lake of the Woods Tourism, Border information: 'The Northwest Angle has been granted a special use to use the App on smart phones' (CBP ROAM): https://lakeofthewoodsmn.com/border-information

US Customs and Border Protection, CBP Introduces a New Application for Small Boat Reporting in the Great Lakes: ROAM = Reporting Offsite Arrival - Mobile; 'The CBPO may initiate a video chat to further interview travelers': https://www.cbp.gov/newsroom/local-media-release/new-small-boat-reporting-procedures-now-effect-0

Map data: Natural Earth (public domain) https://www.naturalearthdata.com and US Census Bureau cartographic boundary files (public domain) https://www.census.gov/geographies/mapping-files/time-series/geo/carto-boundary-file.html; drive and boat routes are drawn schematically

scenes.narration: To drive to this corner of Minnesota, you have to go through Canada.
From Warroad, you cross into Manitoba and ride about {40 miles|forty miles} through Canada.
Back on US soil, you check in on the {CBP ROAM|C.B.P. Roam} app. An officer may video-call you.

data.source: CBP; Lake of the Woods Tourism

scenes.narration: It's the Northwest Angle. And yes: to drive there, you go through Canada.
